market_expectations.current_public_evidence: Recurring revenue, RPO and reported FCF are strong, while Q1 collection seasonality, SBC, acquisition integration and the USD 25 billion debt-funded ASR reduce confidence in simply capitalizing trailing FCF. / 经常性收入、RPO与报告FCF较强，但第一季度回款季节性、SBC、收购整合及250亿美元债务融资ASR降低了直接资本化历史FCF的可信度。
market_expectations.potential_variant: The upside variant requires normalized FCF to remain at or above the current base through seasonally weaker quarters while AI/Data and Informatica contribution exceed consensus without additional leverage. / 上行差异要求标准化FCF在回款季节性较弱季度后仍不低于当前基准，同时AI/数据与Informatica贡献超越一致预期且不增加杠杆。
market_expectations.disconfirming_evidence: The variant would weaken if FCF falls below USD 12 billion, cRPO or revenue misses guidance, SBC dilution rises materially, or leverage constrains reinvestment. / 若FCF低于120亿美元、cRPO或收入未达指引、SBC稀释显著上升，或杠杆限制再投资，则差异化观点被削弱。

assumptions: 10.0x is a round reverse-valuation reference near the observed trailing P/FCF of approximately 9.33x; it is not asserted as fair value.
The metric is equity FCF after cash capex, so debt is not subtracted again in the price formula.
The reverse calculation asks what FCF the dated market cap requires; it does not claim the market explicitly uses this method.
Point-in-time cover-page shares reflect the large ASR better than diluted weighted-average shares but do not capture final ASR settlement.

scenarios.name: Bear
scenarios.key_driver: Revenue/cRPO slow, integration costs and seasonally weaker collections reduce cash conversion, while leverage limits flexibility. / 收入与cRPO放缓、整合成本及季节性较弱回款降低现金转化，杠杆限制灵活性。
scenarios.falsification_trigger: Normalized FCF remains above USD 14.661 billion through weaker collection quarters and revenue stays within guidance. / 若标准化FCF在回款较弱季度后仍高于146.61亿美元且收入保持在指引内，则Bear情景被推翻。
scenarios.notes: USD 12.0 billion is an 18.1502% decline from the validated base; 8x is an analyst downside multiple, not a peer fact. / 120亿美元较已验证基准下降18.1502%；8倍为分析师下行倍数，并非同业事实。

scenarios.name: Base
scenarios.key_driver: Subscription growth and RPO support the current FCF base, but seasonality, SBC and financing costs prevent an immediate durability upgrade. / 订阅增长与RPO支持当前FCF基准，但季节性、SBC与融资成本使可持续性尚不能立即上调。
scenarios.falsification_trigger: Normalized FCF falls below USD 13.677 billion, revenue misses guidance or leverage constrains operating investment. / 若标准化FCF低于136.77亿美元、收入未达指引或杠杆限制经营投入，则Base情景被推翻。
scenarios.notes: The base retains validated LTM FCF and applies the disclosed 10x reverse-valuation reference. / Base保留已验证LTM FCF，并采用已披露的10倍反向估值参考。

scenarios.name: Bull
scenarios.key_driver: AI/Data and Informatica lift growth beyond consensus while margins, collections and capital allocation remain disciplined. / AI、数据与Informatica推动增长超越一致预期，同时利润率、回款与资本配置保持纪律。
scenarios.falsification_trigger: Revenue and cRPO merely match or miss consensus, normalized FCF remains below USD 16 billion, or leverage/dilution increases. / 若收入与cRPO仅达到或低于一致预期、标准化FCF低于160亿美元，或杠杆与稀释上升，则Bull情景被推翻。
scenarios.notes: USD 17.0 billion is 15.9539% above the validated base; 12x requires evidence beyond current consensus. / 170亿美元较已验证基准高15.9539%；12倍要求超越当前一致预期的证据。

peer_valuation_context.selection_rationale: No period-aligned peer set with consistent FCF and SBC definitions was validated. / 尚未验证期间对齐且FCF与SBC定义一致的同业集合。

source_of_fcf: Positive LTM reported CFO after cash interest, cash taxes and working-capital movements / 正的LTM报告CFO，已包含现金利息、现金税与营运资金变动
Low reported cash capex relative to a subscription software model / 相对于订阅软件模式较低的报告现金资本开支
fcf_quality_assessment.sustainability_assessment: The amount is reproducible, but durability must be tested through seasonally weaker collection quarters and against SBC dilution, acquisition integration and higher financing costs. / 该金额可复算，但可持续性必须在回款季节性较弱季度中验证，并考虑SBC稀释、收购整合及更高融资成本。
fcf_quality_assessment.conclusion: FCF quality is adequate for scenario construction, but trailing cash cannot yet be treated as a fully normalized economic run-rate. / FCF质量足以用于情景构建，但历史现金流尚不能视为完全标准化的经济运行率。

dimensions.dimension: Reported-to-normalized bridge / 报告至标准化桥接
dimensions.implication: No unsupported add-backs or CFO double counting. / 不作无依据加回，也不重复计算CFO项目。
Q1 is unusually strong; durability requires later-quarter evidence. / 第一季度通常较强，可持续性需要后续季度证据。

dimensions.dimension: SBC and capital allocation / SBC与资本配置
dimensions.implication: SBC is dilutive and the debt-funded ASR changes per-share and leverage economics. / SBC具有稀释性，债务融资ASR改变每股与杠杆经济。

limitations: No multi-quarter economic FCF normalization after SBC is validated.
Final ASR settlement and incremental cash-interest bridge remain unavailable.

investment_decision_summary.current_view: Salesforce's dated market cap requires about USD 13.677 billion of FCF at the selected 10x reference, below validated LTM FCF of USD 14.661 billion, so public data supports continued valuation work. A stronger action is not yet justified because Q1 collections are seasonally strong, SBC remains material, Informatica integration is incomplete and the USD 25 billion debt-funded ASR materially changed leverage. / 按选定10倍参考，Salesforce当前市值要求约136.77亿美元FCF，低于已验证LTM FCF的146.61亿美元，因此公开资料支持继续估值研究；但第一季度回款季节性较强、SBC规模重要、Informatica整合未完成且250亿美元债务融资ASR显著改变杠杆，尚不足以支持更强判断。
what_would_make_attractive: Normalized FCF remains above USD 14.661 billion through seasonally weaker quarters while revenue and cRPO meet or exceed guidance. / 在回款季节性较弱季度后，标准化FCF仍高于146.61亿美元，且收入与cRPO达到或超过指引。
Final ASR economics and incremental financing costs are disclosed without weakening minimum liquidity or reinvestment capacity. / ASR最终经济结果与增量融资成本披露，且不削弱最低流动性或再投资能力。
what_would_invalidate: Normalized FCF falls below USD 12 billion without a clearly temporary collection-timing cause. / 若不存在明确且暂时的回款时点原因，标准化FCF低于120亿美元。
Revenue/cRPO miss guidance while SBC dilution or leverage rises and constrains product investment. / 收入或cRPO未达指引，同时SBC稀释或杠杆上升并限制产品投入。
what_to_monitor_next: Revenue, cRPO, GAAP margin, SBC, quarterly collections and normalized LTM FCF. / 收入、cRPO、GAAP利润率、SBC、季度回款及标准化LTM FCF。
Final ASR settlement, share count, cash interest, debt maturities, minimum liquidity and Informatica contribution. / ASR最终结算、股数、现金利息、债务到期、最低流动性及Informatica贡献。

upgrade_conditions: Upgrade valuation confidence if normalized FCF remains above USD 14.661 billion after seasonally weaker quarters. / 若标准化FCF在回款较弱季度后仍高于146.61亿美元，则上调估值可信度。
Upgrade the operating view if revenue and cRPO exceed guidance while GAAP margin and SBC discipline do not weaken. / 若收入与cRPO超过指引，同时GAAP利润率与SBC纪律不转弱，则上调经营判断。
Upgrade balance-sheet confidence when final ASR economics, incremental cash interest and numerical covenant headroom are reproducible. / 当ASR最终经济结果、增量现金利息及契约数值余量可复算时，上调资产负债表可信度。
downgrade_conditions: Downgrade if normalized FCF falls below USD 13.677 billion or management reduces FY2027 FCF-growth guidance below 4%. / 若标准化FCF低于136.77亿美元，或管理层将2027财年FCF增长指引下调至4%以下，则下调判断。
Downgrade if revenue or cRPO misses guidance for two comparable periods. / 若收入或cRPO连续两个可比期间未达指引，则下调判断。
Downgrade if SBC dilution, integration spending or cash interest materially weakens per-share cash economics. / 若SBC稀释、整合支出或现金利息显著削弱每股现金经济，则下调判断。
thesis_invalidation_conditions: Invalidate the FCF valuation thesis if normalized FCF is below USD 12 billion without a clearly reversible collection-timing cause. / 若标准化FCF低于120亿美元且不存在明确可逆的回款时点原因，则FCF估值逻辑失效。
Invalidate the differentiated growth thesis if AI/Data and Informatica results merely match or miss consensus while leverage remains elevated. / 若AI、数据与Informatica结果仅达到或低于一致预期且杠杆仍高，则差异化增长逻辑失效。

Invalidate the no-immediate-credit-constraint conclusion upon material liquidity loss, covenant breach or inability to refinance maturities on acceptable terms. / 若流动性大幅下降、违反契约，或无法以可接受条件再融资到期债务，则“无即时信用约束”结论失效。

catalysts: Normalized FCF remaining above USD 14.661 billion after seasonally weaker quarters. / 标准化FCF在回款较弱季度后仍高于146.61亿美元。
Revenue and cRPO exceeding guidance with stable GAAP margin and SBC discipline. / 收入与cRPO超过指引，同时GAAP利润率与SBC纪律稳定。
Final ASR settlement and a reproducible financing-cost/liquidity bridge. / ASR最终结算及可复算的融资成本与流动性桥接。

credit_constraint_status.basis: Cash and marketable securities, an undrawn revolver and no principal due in the remainder of FY2027 or FY2028 do not show an immediate funding wall. The conclusion remains qualified because debt-funded capital allocation materially increased fixed obligations and numerical covenant headroom is unavailable. / 现金及有价证券、未使用循环授信及2027财年余下期间与2028财年无本金到期，未显示即时融资墙；但债务融资资本配置显著增加固定义务，且契约数值余量不可得，因此结论仍为有条件。
